commits.author: Marco Andronaco
commits.subject: feat: apply streamed message.part events for gradual token rendering
commits.body:
Previously any message./session./todo. SSE event only triggered a
debounced full re-fetch of the session's messages, so assistant
replies appeared to update in ~250ms chunks rather than as tokens
were generated. Now message.part.updated (full part snapshot) and
message.part.delta (incremental field delta, e.g. streamed text) are
applied directly to local message state as they arrive, so text
renders progressively while the debounced refresh still runs as a
reconciliation fallback.

+function applyStreamedPartUpdate(messages: MessageEnvelope[], sessionID: string, part: MessagePart): MessageEnvelope[] {
+  let changed = false
+  const next = messages.map((message) => {
+    if (message.info.sessionID !== sessionID || message.info.id !== part.messageID) return message
+    changed = true
+    const exists = message.parts.some((existing) => existing.id === part.id)
+    const parts = exists
+      ? message.parts.map((existing) => (existing.id === part.id ? part : existing))
+      : [...message.parts, part]
+    return { ...message, parts }
+  })
+  return changed ? next : messages
+}
+
+function applyStreamedPartDelta(
+  messages: MessageEnvelope[],
+  sessionID: string,
+  messageID: string,
+  partID: string,
+  field: string,
+  delta: string
+): MessageEnvelope[] {
+  let changed = false
+  const next = messages.map((message) => {
+    if (message.info.sessionID !== sessionID || message.info.id !== messageID) return message
+    const parts = message.parts.map((existing) => {
+      if (existing.id !== partID) return existing
+      changed = true
+      const current = (existing as Record<string, unknown>)[field]
+      const nextValue = (typeof current === "string" ? current : "") + delta
+      return { ...existing, [field]: nextValue }
+    })
+    return changed ? { ...message, parts } : message
+  })
+  return changed ? next : messages
+}
